Here we summarize the results of the updated udr analysis of the GTEx
data.

```{r knitr-opts, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = "#",collapse = TRUE,results = "hold",
                      fig.align = "center",dpi = 120)
```

Load the packages used in the analyses below:

```{r load-pkgs, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
```

Load the z-scores:

```{r load-data}
dat <- readRDS("data/data_analysis/GTEx_V8_strong_z.rds")
dim(dat$strong.z)
```

Load the results of the cross-validation:

```{r load-cv}
load("output/data_analysis/gtex_cv_out.RData")
```
